info.title: Chaos Commerce Store API
info.description: Public Storefront API authenticated by Store-scoped public keys.

get.summary: List active and published Products with active prices

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Active Collection handle published to the current Sales Channel. Results preserve manual Collection order.

get.summary: Get one active and published Product by handle
List active Collections published to the current Sales Channel
Get an active Collection published to the current Sales Channel

post.summary: Collect a bounded batch of first-party behavior events
post.description: Browser events carry no consumer identity; the API derives shopper_id from the signed shopper token. Event-specific values are stored as dynamic JSON properties. Cart, checkout, payment, purchase, and refund outcomes are recorded by authoritative server workflows.

200.description: Batch accepted with duplicate event IDs reported separately

post.summary: Create an anonymous possession-bound shopper session
Create an active Cart using the current Price List

put.summary: Add a Cart line or replace its quantity and current snapshot

post.summary: Create a Stripe Embedded Checkout Session with a provisional Order
post.description: Reserves tracked inventory and creates a provisional Order. Stripe Embedded Checkout collects the shopper's shipping address, phone, billing details, shipping option, tax, and payment details. The Order is confirmed only after the verified Stripe webhook.

201.description: Embedded Checkout Session created and client handoff returned

get.summary: Get an Order and its transition audit trail

post.summary: Read one Order with a tracking token

publishableKey.description: An active Store-scoped public key in pk_<24-character Base58 format.

Currency.name: currency
Currency.description: The Store currency used when no currency is specified.

ShopperToken.name: x-chaos-shopper-token
ShopperToken.description: Signed shopper credential returned when the website visitor session is created. Never place this value in URLs or logs.

properties.description: Event-specific values. The server requires an object and permits store-defined fields.

shopper_token.description: Signed possession credential for one anonymous shopper session.

return_url.description: Stripe returns the shopper here after Embedded Checkout completes. HTTPS is required except for local loopback development. Chaos appends order_id to the query string.

type.description: client_token is an Embedded Checkout Session client secret.

Forbidden.description: Credential class or scope is not allowed

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not visible to this Store credential

Conflict.description: Idempotency conflict, terminal Cart, stale price, or insufficient inventory

ValidationFailed.description: Invalid header, body, query, or path value

RateLimited.description: Store, Sales Channel, or Shopper collection budget exceeded

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current fixed collection window expires

Unavailable.description: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable
